text: NotificationFilter rejects a supplied URL whose extracted scheme is not https and rejects extraction errors. The test includes a non-HTTPS URL containing /https:// to prove a substring is insufficient, and observes the parse-error log before checking a malformed value. Empty or absent URL does not fail this particular gate. Bypass filtering returns earlier, so do not call this an unconditional guarantee for every manager or test input.
title: Validate the notification URL scheme rather than searching its text
